notes.title: Hitmen Havoc is OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Hitmen Havoc is out now!
What started with one developer’s dream (and a love for multiplayer classics like Worms, Liero, and Gorillas) has grown into a team of four maniacs with an idea: make a game for friends, old and new, with just the right amount of chaos. We’ve taken inspiration from all over—ROUNDS, Bople Battle, Brawlhalla, Duck Game—you name it! 

But unlike some of those other games, Hitmen Havoc lets you party with up to 8 players. No more capping the fun at 2 or 4—we're going all in.

Ever been playing with friends and suddenly someone leaves?
Or worse, someone joins and you’ve now got an odd number? No worries—our fast-paced matches mean they can hop in and be shooting you (or saving you) within seconds. We’ve got loads of match options to customize your experience however you want:


 Snipers-only instant kill mode? Done.
 Team Deathmatch with bots to even things out? Yep, we’ve got that too.
 Knockout melee-only mode? We got you!
 Want to cause chaos with custom rules? Go for it!


And here’s the best part: there are no microtransactions, no battle passes, no gems, and no loot boxes. Just pure, unfiltered fun.
Buy the game to unlock all characters or keep playing the free demo while playing with friends who own the full version—your choice!

If you’re cool with some mild cartoony violence, younger gamers can join in the fun too.

A huge thank you to everyone who tested, reported bugs, and gave us feedback—you’re the real MVPs. We couldn’t have made it this far without you!

See you in the arena!
- TangleTech

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the grenade throw line would stay if dying while throwing.
 Fixed a bug that made players start spinning rapidly.
 Fixed an audio glitch causing music to stutter.
 Fixed the display settings to correctly show the current screen mode.
 Improved performance and fixed various map issues.
 Implemented a system that scales the number of weapon and power ups based on the number of players 
 The in game language should now match the player's set language on Steam.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 0.4.8
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where non-master clients sometimes could not spawn correctly or weapons not showing correctly.
 Fixed a bug causing bots to break if a player left the game.
 Correctly set the default window mode on launch.



And other minor adjustments

notes.title: Update 0.4.7
notes.content:
New Features
Reflective Water: Added new reflective water to enhance visual effects.

Improvements
Camera Enhancements: Various camera improvements for better gameplay experience.
Map Performance: Various map improvements to enhance performance.

Bug Fixes

 Bot Limit Fix: Fixed the number of bots that can join if real players are not found using “Quick Play”.
 Kimiko's Death Animation: Fixed Kimiko's death animation.
 Cursor Lock: Cursor is now only locked on screen while playing in Full Screen mode.
 Projectile Bug: Fixed a bug where projectiles would stop on death.
 Spawn Invulnerability: Spawn invulnerability shield now correctly protects against knock back.
 Weapon Pickup: Same weapons can now be picked up if ammo is not full.
 Weapon HUD: Show weapon HUD while waiting for respawn.
Projectiles Bug: Fixed a bug where projectiles would go thru players if they stood too close.

notes.title: Update 0.4.5
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with how Kimiko despawned on death.


 Stabilized how turning and aiming around works.


 The game should now correctly display native resolution as default.


 Punching will now interrupt shooting for a brief moment.


 Fixed various map issues and bad spawn locations.

notes.title: Hitmen Havoc Update Q2 2024
notes.content:
New Weapon Mechanics

All weapons have been revamped to make each feel unique and balanced. Here are some highlights:


 Sniper: Now capable of shooting through multiple enemies.


 Crossbows: Now shoot two bolts simultaneously and have a knockback effect.


 Laser Blaster: Charge up for a devastating energy blast.


 RPG: Improved to cause damage to multiple enemies.


Weapon Lives


Keep your gun for up to 2 deaths, making your strategies more dynamic.


Brand New Punching


This isn't just a nudge or slap; deliver powerful knockbacks to send your friends flying!


Energy Grenades


Charge and hold for a longer throw distance, adding a new layer to your combat tactics.


Animations


All animations have been remade from scratch, and they look better than ever.


Game Start Mechanics



 From now on, everyone starts with Pistols and must fight for better weapon spawns and powerups.


 Pistols have infinite ammo but require time to reload between clips.



Powerup Spawns


Powerup spawns have been improved. You will no longer pick up and waste a health pack when you're at full health.


Optimization and Stability


Lots of optimization and stability work has been done. The build is much lighter and should be playable on much older hardware.


We’re excited for you to experience these updates and improvements. As always, thank you for your support and feedback. Jump into the chaos and have fun!

notes.title: Gameplay Revolution - Major Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107585/b1637d84ff0f286b3be87a3ff93775153b38c928.png
🎉 Hitmen Havoc Heroes! Grab your weapons and prepare for mayhem, because our latest update is here to rock your world! 💥🔫
🪙 We've added brand new maps, spiced up the visuals, and even polished the bullets! But that's not all—gameplay has never been this smooth, and those pesky bugs are history! 🐞🛠️
💃 So, don your wildest attire, gather your squad, and let the party begin! Hitmen Havoc is now even more epic and chaotic than ever before! Let's dive into the action together! 🚀🎮

Content and Visuals:

Added 11 brand new maps.
Reworked lighting and shadows.
Improved projectile and weapon FX.
Added new cosmetic items.

Gameplay and Mechanics:

Improved movement on slopes.
Improved player and item spawns.
Improved bot AI.
Custom games now join back together to the lobby after the game.
Simplified the score system.
Balanced ammunition amounts.
Improved jumping control.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed several smaller bugs.
Fixed a bug where lobbies would not show up in the browser.
Fixed a bug where dead players were blocking other players.
Fixed a bug where jumping wasn't shown correctly for other players.
Fixed a bug where sprites were flickering.
Fixed a bug where weapons had too much recoil.
Fixed a bug where a player would automatically jump again when jumping through a platform.
Fixed various lobby UI issues between the host and other clients.

Stability and Performance:

Improved overall game stability.
Improved moving platform synchronization.
Several camera improvements.
Improved lobby matchmaking.
Several UI-menu improvements.
Improved look and feel, including feedback and camera zoom.
